description: Deploy a model on dedicated GPUs. The endpoint STARTS AUTOMATICALLY and bills per minute of uptime until stopped — set inactive_timeout to auto-stop it, and use together_list_hardware for valid hardware ids. Together: POST /endpoints.

max_replicas.description: Maximum replicas to scale up to under load.

min_replicas.description: Replicas kept running even with no load.

inactive_timeout.description: Minutes of inactivity before auto-stop; 0 disables it.

state.description: Initial state. Pass STOPPED to create without starting (and without billing).

name: together_create_endpoint
title: Create a dedicated endpoint
